name: Ghost Cab
description: An unlicensed, unregistered taxi service operating in Tier 1-2 districts where Tessera AutoCabs won't go. Ghost Cabs are civilian vehicles — sedans, vans, anything with seats — driven by individuals operating outside the system. No records, no surveillance, no tracking. You flag one down, you negotiate a price, you get where you're going with no data trail. The drivers know every checkpoint, every camera blind spot, every back route. They are the transportation network of the invisible city — the one that exists in the gaps between what's monitored.
propulsion: Whatever the vehicle has — electric, hydrogen, even fossil fuel
cost: Φ5-20 per ride (negotiable, cash or untraceable Quanta)
armament: Whatever the driver carries. Trust is the only safety system.
common_usage: Off-grid transit, avoiding surveillance, late-night transport in unserved areas, moving people who don't officially exist.
story_hooks: A Ghost Cab driver has been operating for twenty years and has a perfect memory of every passenger — they know the secret history of the city
Ghost Cab drivers are being targeted and killed, one by one, by someone who is erasing the off-grid transport network
